analytics._readme: Paste public measurement IDs here and run tools/build.py. Empty fields inject nothing.

seasons.heading: Black Friday deals, live early
seasons.note: Black Friday is Friday, Nov 27. Cyber Monday is Nov 30. These brands started early. None of them posts an end date, so if you see a price you like, don't wait for Friday.

seasons.heading: Black Friday deals
seasons.note: Black Friday weekend. Cyber Monday is Nov 30. The brands don't post end dates, so prices can change any hour.

seasons.heading: Cyber Monday deals
seasons.note: Cyber Monday, Nov 30. Last call on most holiday prices. Brands don't post end dates.
